answer: Proof of history builds a sequential hash chain where each step hashes the previous output together with new events, creating a verifiable ordering of what happened and when relative to other entries. A reef of ordered events is locked in sequence, a lotus blooming at one link cannot be moved earlier without recomputing everything after it, and a nebula of later entries confirms the chain kept growing. Unlike a single delayed output, this chain records a continuous order, so a farm cannot insert fake identities retroactively without redoing the whole chain.
